segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Hello, can I help you?

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: I was told to come here, because I'd like to talk to someone about taking a management course.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Right. I'm one of the tutors, so I should be able to help you.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Oh, good. My name's Brian Ardley. I've decided to enrol on a part- time management course. A friend of mine took one last year, and recommended it to me.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Right.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Is there anything I should do before the course, like reading or anything?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: We prefer to integrate reading with the course, so we don't give out a reading list in advance. But we like people to write a case study, describing an organisation they know.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: I've already done that, as my friends told me you wanted one. But would it te possible to sit in on a teaching session, to see what it's like? haven't been a student for quite a while.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Fine. Just Jet me know which date, and I'll arrange it with the tutor.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Now, could I ask you about the college facilities, please?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Anything in particular?

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Well, the course is one day a week, all day, isn't it? So presumably it's possible to buy food?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Yes, the refectory's open all day.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Does it cater for special diets? I have some food allergies.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Provided you warn the refectory in advance, it won't be a problem.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Good. What about facilities for young children? I'd like to bring my daughter here while I'm studying.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: How old is she?

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Three.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Then she's eligible to join the nursery, which is supervised by a qualified Nursery Nurse. The waiting list for a place is quite long though, so you ought to apply now.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: I don't know if our careers advice service would be of any interest to you?

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Yes, it might help me decide how to develop my career after the course.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: The centre has a lot of reference materials, and staff qualified to give guidance on a one-to-one basis.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: I noticed a fitness centre next to the college. Is that for students?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: It's open to everyone, but students pay an annual fee that's much less than the general public pay.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: And presumably the college library stocks newspapers and journals, as well as books?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Yes, and there's also an audio-visual room, for viewing and listening to videos, cassettes, and so on.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Is there also access to computers?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Yes, your tutor will need to arrange with the technical support team for you to get a password, so ask him or her about it when you start the course.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: By the way, do you know about our Business Centre?

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: No. What's that?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: It's a training resource- a collection of materials for people to study on their own, or use in their own organisations.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Uhuh. You mean books and videos?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Yes, and manuals for self-study. Plus a lot of computer-based materials, so people can work through them at their own speed, and anything they aren't sure about. And you can hire~ to use in your own /27 home or workplace as well as printers that you can take away. /27

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Does it have anything that I could use to improve my study skills? I don't have much idea about report writing, and I'm sure I'll need it on the course.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Oh yes, there's plenty of useful material. Just ask one of the staff.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Does the centre cover all the main areas of business?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Yes, topics like finance, and of course marketing - that's a popular one. Local managers seem to queue up to borrow the videos!

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: So it isn't just for students, then?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: No, it's for members only, but anyone can join.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: How much does it cost?

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: £100 a year for a company, and £50 for an individual, with no discount for students, I'm afraid.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: That's very helpful. Well, I think that's all. I'd better go home and fill in the enrolment form. Thanks for all your help.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: You're welcome. Goodbye.

segments.speaker: BRIAN
segments.en: Goodbye.
